lane: Operator-reported defect: Learning objectives render as one continuous paragraph
surface: apps/hub/src/components/books/lesson/lesson-view.tsx (the objectives box under the lesson h1)
root_cause_of_record: learningObjective is a single authored string (types.ts:1824, string | null) packing the objectives with ';' chains and inline bullet separators — lesson-view rendered it bare ({pack.learningObjective}) inside the box, so JSX whitespace handling collapsed everything into one run-on paragraph.
census_of_record: 27 packs carry a non-null learningObjective; ALL 27 pack multiple objectives; delimiters: ; x170, bullet x34, newline x0; worst case: 'Chemical tests' — 21 objectives flattened into one paragraph. Corpus verified at scripts time (python, receipt-grade).
the_fix: ObjectiveList (lesson-view.tsx): split the authored string on /;/•/, trim, drop empties; a first piece ending with ':' renders as the lead line above the list (the 'rules: • a • b' authoring shape — corpus-verified on the solubility pack); the rest render as one li per objective (list-disc pl-5 space-y-0.5, markers inherit; the WS4 box anatomy byte-kept — text-base leading-relaxed, the Target label row). Corpus verification: 229 objective items render across the 27 packs; the alkenes ; -chain -> 3 items; the solubility pack -> lead + 2 items.

gates.full_battery: 1332 pass / 10 fail / 39,164 expects across 95 files — fail set A/B-IDENTICAL to the WS7-turn capture at the same base (diff empty)
gates.note: no new tailwind utilities beyond the standard list voices (list-disc/pl-5 are core); no emission-gate needed

disclosures: The ';' split assumes authored objectives never embed a semicolon mid-sentence — the census (170 ';' boundaries across 27 packs, all reading as objective boundaries) supports this; any future pack violating it will show an extra item, not a broken layout.
The bullets-after-colon shape renders the colon piece as lead text, not a bullet — the author's intent per the solubility pack.
learningObjective strings arrive exactly as authored (books-slices sets null on the manifest path — no joiner normalizes them).
